digest.component_or_area: bridge projects store and CLI/library/MCP surface
propositions: Record project-to-repos mapping in .bridge_state/projects.json owned by projects_store module, separate from bindings and snapshot state to avoid diff conflicts across repos sharing a store
Surface the mapping via bridge projects CLI verb group (list/set/remove subcommands) with parity across library (_lib_ops.py), MCP read/write tools, and CLI, all operating on the same record

resolve_project implements tri-state rule: absent field returns legacy_default, explicit empty string returns None, set key returns that key; when legacy_default is itself empty, return None (fail-safe until seeded)
set command requires --repos argument (non-zero exit if omitted), accepts empty list via --repos "", and replaces existing repos list idempotently rather than merging
Absent projects.json record reads as empty mapping with None legacy_default (fail-safe); malformed JSON raises; ensure units in dependent story 462d-8d84 seed the record at init/fsck/MCP boot
Mapping writes preserve bindings.json and prev_snapshot.json byte-identically; pinned help text in bridge.txt and argparse metavar verb set both must name projects subcommand
